text: Ɗee lepte saɗtuɗe ɗoo heɓayɓe ñalnde darngal tuma geece yimɓe gomɗinal ɓen ranwoyta welo-welo e maloore, geece heeferɓe ɓen ɓawlira suno e aannde. Si ko ɓen ɓe geece mu'un ɓawli nden ñalnde mawnde, ɓe feliroyte wi'eede: "E on yeddu bajjinɗingol Alla ngol e Ahadi Makko ndin, ndi O Ahodi e mo'on wonnde on kafidataa Mo hay e huunde, jaɓuɗon ɗum qirritiɗon?! Awa meeɗee lepte Alla ɗen ɗe O Hebilani on sabu keeferaaku mo'on.
